title: Public officials told: No Christmas solicitations
summary: The Office of the Ombudsman has warned public officials and employees against soliciting donations for Christmas parties and other unauthorized purposes, after suspending a barangay secretary in…

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Office of the Ombudsman has warned public officials and employees against soliciting donations for Christmas parties and other unauthorized purposes, after suspending a barangay secretary in Makati over solicitation letters using official government letterhead.
Olegario was found to have issued letters in December 2025 asking for cash or in-kind donations from private individuals for the barangay officials’ and personnel’s Christmas party.

The ombudsman said that using the authority and resources of public office resources to solicit donations “for a purpose not shown to be a governmental function is inconsistent with the standards of integrity and propriety expected of public employees.”

“It creates the appearance that the government itself is requesting private individuals to provide money or property for the benefit of its personnel. This is precisely the type of conduct that may diminish public confidence,” it said.
